# Major Context

> Developer tools for running AI agents safely.

## Products

- [Moat](https://majorcontext.com/moat/llms.txt): Let agents break things safely
- [Keep](https://majorcontext.com/keep/llms.txt): Policy engine for AI agent tool calls
- [Gatekeeper](https://majorcontext.com/gatekeeper/llms.txt): Credential-injecting TLS-intercepting proxy
